scope: 38 active individually authored math questions and one retired question preserved for historical attempts.
method: Fresh exact models of all prompt constraints, symbolic solutions and comparison of every option. English choices and geometric descriptions are translated into mathematical statements editorially; the program does not infer diagrams or natural language automatically.
